events.subject: Speculative footwear workshop application, Vienna - Mohammed Fadil
events.body:
Dear Ludwig Reiter Recruitment Team,

Your careers page welcomes applications for the Vienna shoe manufacture. I am applying speculatively for suitable footwear-making, stitching or finishing employment there. I am interested in contributing practical leather skills while learning your shoemaking methods. This is a manufacturing application, rather than an application for your advertised Graz retail position.

Please find my CV, personalized cover letter and work portfolio with project photographs and certificate copies.

I am a Moroccan national living in Morocco, without Austrian residence or work authorization. My English and French are A2; German is A1, studying for A2. I would need an appropriate employer-supported employment and residence route before starting. Could you advise whether you consider workshop applicants from Morocco and what language, experience and documents you require?

Please advise the role, location, weekly hours, gross pay and language requirements. I could start after the required authorizations and visa.

Kind regards,
Mohammed Fadil
+212 603 574 848
mfadil.med@gmail.com
